arStrings.szText: "What do you know of this place?"
Good-child, this "place" is where life began. The Creators met on these very stones and dreamed what the plants and animals would be.
Almost offended. Suddenly eager to educate.
You can still feel their magic in the air. Beautiful and dangerous... (sighs) But never as bad as this.
Thoughtful, then returning to the present, disturbed by the horrors of the attack.
